params.name: ground_source
params.why: data/derived/elbaext/corrections_geoid.json ground_source; the same source the anchor's ties were read on

params.name: csf_crop_halfwidth_m
params.why: CSF is run on a crop, not a tile, to keep it seconds instead of minutes. Copied unchanged from analysis/groundtruth/elba_absolute_tie.py so the two runs are the same method; its effect is measured below by re-reading every mark with the vendor class-2 ground, which uses no crop at all

params.name: siting_radius_m
params.why: ADDITIONAL_GROUND_CONTROL.md section 7.1 states the screen at R = 5 m; kept at 5 m so this run is comparable to the 17 measurements there

params.name: geoid_shift_m
params.why: the 2008 control and the raw gen1 cloud are both NAVD88(GEOID03) (lidar_semn2008.html); no conversion enters this comparison

params.name: lateral_shift_m
params.why: data/derived/elbaext/corrections_geoid.json cross_epoch_datum.horizontal_shift_m: the elbaext Nuth-Kaaeb shift, reported applied AND withheld because the 2008 control is in gen1's own horizontal frame

params.name: swath_chain
params.why: every mark here lies under a gen1 flight line in a tile on disk, so no chain link is needed -- which is the whole point of this control set

columns.tie_mm: surveyed - z_lidar, mm; POSITIVE = gen1 reads BELOW the mark
columns.dnr_mm: the MnDNR table's own Error = Control Z - delivered 2008 DEM, mm; same sign family, different surface
columns.spread_mm: p05-p95 of ground returns within the siting radius (section 7.1)
columns.ctrl_pct: percentile of the surveyed elevation within those returns; near 50 is well sited, a tail is not
columns.sigma_mm: half the tie spread over the pipeline-scale radii (res/2..2*res)
columns.point: MnDNR 2008 control point name; the prefix is its land-cover class
columns.cover: land-cover class from the point name: L1O open, L2T tall weeds/crops, L3B brush/low trees, L4F forested, L5U urban
columns.what: what the land-cover class means, from lidar_semn2008.html
columns.km: distance from the Elba reference point (579705.72, 4883677.71), km
columns.tile: the gen1 tile the mark falls in, already on disk
columns.n: ground returns inside the report radius (or the siting radius, in the siting tables)
columns.lines: distinct flight lines contributing inside the report radius
columns.tie_nolat_mm: the same tie with the elbaext lateral shift WITHHELD
columns.mean_tie_mm: mean of tie_mm over the marks of this class
columns.median_tie_mm: median of tie_mm over the marks of this class
columns.SE_mm: standard error of the mean over the marks in the row
columns.mean_spread_mm: mean of spread_mm over the marks of this class
columns.mean_dnr_mm: mean of dnr_mm over the marks of this class
columns.quantity: which estimate of the gen1 datum constant this row holds
columns.mm: its value in mm, on the tie = surveyed - z_lidar convention
columns.note: how the row was obtained, or what qualifies it
columns.line: gen1 flight line (LAS point_source_id) the tie was read on alone
columns.mixed_tie_mm: the tie for this mark with all lines pooled, mm, for comparison with the per-line reads
columns.type: 3DEP accuracy class: NVA open ground, VVA under vegetation
columns.mean_mm: mean of the MnDNR Error over the marks in the row, mm
columns.median_mm: median of the MnDNR Error over the marks in the row, mm
columns.L1O_mean_mm: mean MnDNR Error over the OPEN-cover marks of the row only
columns.n_L1O: how many of the row's marks are open cover
columns.stat: which statistic of (our point-cloud tie - the MnDNR table's own Error) is on this row, with its units
columns.value: the value of the statistic named in the 'stat' column, in the units that column states (mm, or dimensionless for a count or a correlation)
columns.stratum: which marks the plane was fitted to
columns.radius_km: marks within this distance of the Elba reference point
columns.intercept_mm: the fitted plane's value AT the Elba reference point, mm
columns.dE_mm_per_km: east gradient of the fitted plane, mm/km
columns.dN_mm_per_km: north gradient of the fitted plane, mm/km
columns.resid_rms_mm: RMS of the marks about the fitted plane, mm
columns.county: MnGeo validation report the mark came from

headline: gen1's own 2008 control, measured on the point cloud with the anchor's estimator
